description: ALWAYS use this skill whenever you would otherwise ask the user a question in free-form chat -- for clarifications, confirmations (especially destructive actions), missing parameters, multiple-choice decisions, or structured form input. Elicitations are routed through the Unique AI Platform UI via `unique-cli elicit create` + `elicit wait` (the default polling pattern) or a single supervised `unique-cli elicit ask` call (only when your agent instructions say your environment supervises the wait) so the user gets a proper structured prompt and you get a structured answer back. Do NOT ask the user in plain chat when you can use this skill instead.
